title: SPW-Nav: A Streaming Panoramic World Model for Language-Guided Navigation
title_zh: SPW-Nav：一种用于语言引导导航的流式全景世界模型

paragraphs.en: 1]Alaya Lab 2]Peking University 3]Institute of Science Tokyo \github https://alaya-lab.github.io/SPW-Nav
paragraphs.zh: 1]Alaya Lab 2]北京大学 3]东京理科大学 \github https://alaya-lab.github.io/SPW-Nav

paragraphs.en: Language-guided panoramic video generation benefits various downstream applications, such as interactive 3D scene exploration, virtual reality experiences, and embodied agent training. Existing panoramic generators follow predefined trajectories, and interactive world models act through low-level actions in perspective views. We propose SPW-Nav, a streaming panoramic world model that understands movement instructions and streams one minute of 2K 360° video in real time from a single panorama. SPW-Nav interprets each instruction in the previously generated panorama as camera motion. Spherical rotation decoupling applies rotation exactly on the sphere, pose-aligned conditioning keeps translation inputs bounded over long streams, and a multi-term memory with a few-step generator continues the scene as instructions change. We also build SPW-NavSet, panoramic videos with camera trajectories and verified instructions. Driven by language, SPW-Nav outperforms prior panoramic generators in camera-following accuracy and video quality, and supports on-the-fly instruction switching.
paragraphs.zh: 语言引导的全景视频生成技术可助力多种下游应用，例如交互式三维场景探索、虚拟现实体验以及具身智能体训练。 现有的全景生成器遵循预定义的轨迹，而交互式世界模型则通过视角视图中的低层动作进行交互。 我们提出了 SPW-Nav，这是一种流式全景世界模型，能够理解移动指令，并基于单张全景图实时生成一分钟的 2K 360° 视频。 SPW-Nav 将先前生成的全景图中的每条指令解释为摄像机的运动。 球面旋转解耦技术可确保旋转操作严格作用于球体，姿态对齐条件约束则使平移输入在长时间流中保持有限，而包含多项目记忆和几步生成器的结构则能在指令变化时延续场景。 我们还构建了 SPW-NavSet，即包含摄像机轨迹和经过验证指令的全景视频数据集。 在语言驱动下，SPW-Nav 在摄像机跟随准确性和视频质量方面优于先前的全景生成器，并支持即时切换指令。

paragraphs.en: Generative world models let users and agents explore virtual environments, and exploration requires control over where to move and what to observe next. Panoramic video covers the surroundings in all directions, and natural language expresses movement without camera poses. Language-guided exploration therefore calls for continuous panoramic video that follows a sequence of instructions and stays consistent as the route changes.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式世界模型能让用户和智能体探索虚拟环境，而探索需要控制移动方向以及接下来观察什么。 全景视频覆盖了周围所有方向的环境，而自然语言则无需指定摄像头姿态即可描述移动。 因此，语言引导的探索需要持续播放的全景视频，该视频必须遵循一系列指令，并在路线变化时保持一致性。

paragraphs.en: Prior approaches address only parts of this interaction. Text-to-video models [ 18 , 35 ] condition an entire video on a single prompt. Camera-controlled panoramic generators [ 21 , 28 , 23 ] follow predefined trajectories, while navigation and interactive world models [ 4 , 13 , 6 , 52 , 17 , 29 ] and vision-and-language agents [ 1 , 33 ] act through low-level actions ( e.g . , keyboard inputs), mostly in forward views. None of these video generators understands instructions that refer to scene content ( e.g . , walking to a door behind the camera), and this semantic gap motivates SPW-Nav.
paragraphs.zh: 以往的方法仅解决了这种交互的部分内容。 文本到视频模型 [ 18 , 35 ] 根据单个提示词生成整个视频。 由摄像头控制的全景生成器 [ 21 , 28 , 23 ] 遵循预定义的轨迹，而导航和交互式世界模型 [ 4 , 13 , 6 , 52 , 17 , 29 ] 以及视觉-语言智能体 [ 1 , 33 ] 则通过低层操作（例如键盘输入）进行交互，且主要局限于正面视角。 这些视频生成器都无法理解涉及场景内容的指令（例如，走向摄像头后方的门），这种语义上的缺失正是 SPW-Nav 的出发点。

paragraphs.en: Navigating a generated panoramic world raises three challenges. (i) Scene-dependent navigation. The meaning of an instruction depends on the panorama the model itself generates and therefore cannot be turned into motion in advance. (ii) Camera representation. A panoramic turn only rearranges visible content, yet existing generators synthesize it, and open-ended navigation drives world-frame poses beyond the training range. (iii) Translation following. The camera pose is a weak signal next to rich visual context, and 2K streaming leaves few network evaluations per frame.
paragraphs.zh: 在生成的全景世界中导航会引发三个挑战。 (i) 场景依赖的导航。 指令的含义取决于模型自身生成的全景图，因此无法提前将其转化为运动指令。 (ii) 相机表示。 全景旋转只会重新排列可见内容，但现有生成器会对其进行合成，而开放式的导航会使世界坐标系下的姿态超出训练范围。 (iii) 平移跟随。 与丰富的视觉上下文相比，相机姿态是一个较弱的信号，而 2K 流式传输每帧仅能保留少量网络评估资源。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose SPW-Nav, a S treaming P anoramic W orld model for language-guided Nav igation. As illustrated in Figure 1 , SPW-Nav understands the semantics of movement instructions ( e.g . , walking to the door) and generates one minute of 360° video at 2K resolution ( 1024 × 2048 1024\times 2048 ) and 26.6 FPS from a single panorama. (i) Scene-aware navigation. A vision-language backbone reads the previously generated panorama and turns each instruction into an explicit displacement or a localized goal. (ii) Decoupled camera representation. Spherical rotation decoupling applies the commanded rotation exactly by resampling the sphere, leaving only translation to the video backbone. Pose-aligned conditioning expresses this translation relative to the previous chunk and keeps the pose inputs bounded however long the navigation runs. (iii) Enhanced translation following. Noise-tail trajectory learning focuses training and distillation on high noise levels, where the pose is the main motion cue, and opposite-trajectory guidance contrasts the commanded translation with its reverse at inference. A distilled pyramid generator with sparse attention [ 22 ] and a multi-term memory sustain these one-minute streams. The explicit motion representation lets SPW-Nav learn navigation and generation from complementary data in SPW-NavSet.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 SPW-Nav，这是一种用于语言引导导航的流式全景世界模型。 如图 1 所示，SPW-Nav 能够理解移动指令的语义（例如，走到门口），并基于单个全景图生成一分钟、分辨率为 2K（1024 × 2048）且帧速为 26.6 FPS 的 360° 视频。 (i) 场景感知导航。 一个视觉-语言主干模型会读取先前生成的全景图，并将每条指令转化为明确的位移或局部目标。 (ii) 解耦的相机表示。 球面旋转解耦通过重新采样球面精确执行指定的旋转，从而将仅平移部分留给视频主干模型处理。 姿态对齐的条件化机制将这种平移相对于上一片段进行表达，无论导航持续多久，都能保持姿态输入的有界性。 (iii) 增强的平移跟随能力。 噪声尾部轨迹学习将训练和蒸馏聚焦于高噪声水平——此时姿态是主要运动线索——并在推理阶段通过反向轨迹引导，将指定平移与其相反方向进行对比。 一个采用稀疏注意力 [22] 的蒸馏金字塔生成器与多项记忆机制共同维持这些一分钟长的流式视频。 这种明确的动作表示使 SPW-Nav 能够从 SPW-NavSet 中互补的数据中学习导航和生成任务。

paragraphs.en: We propose SPW-Nav, the first streaming panoramic world model for language-guided navigation, generating one-minute 2K 360° streams at 26.6 FPS. We also build SPW-NavSet, 233 hours of panoramic video with trajectories and verified instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SPW-Nav，这是首个用于语言引导导航的流式全景世界模型，能够以每秒 26.6 帧的速度生成一分钟长的 2K 360° 视频流。 我们还构建了 SPW-NavSet，包含 233 小时的全景视频，并附有轨迹和经过验证的指令。

paragraphs.en: We propose spherical rotation decoupling, which applies rotation exactly on the sphere so that the video backbone models translation alone, and pose-aligned conditioning, which keeps translation inputs bounded however far the navigation goes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了球形旋转解耦方法，该方法将旋转操作精确地应用于球体，使得视频主干模型仅处理平移；同时提出了姿态对齐条件约束方法，无论导航过程有多远，都能保持平移输入在限定范围内。

paragraphs.en: We propose noise-tail trajectory learning and opposite-trajectory guidance to strengthen translation following, and enable streaming by making the video backbone autoregressive with a multi-term memory and distilling it to two steps per pyramid scale.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了噪声尾部轨迹学习和反向轨迹引导方法，以增强翻译跟随能力，并通过使视频主干网络采用多项记忆机制实现自回归处理，并将其蒸馏为每个金字塔尺度两步操作，从而支持流式处理。

paragraphs.en: Panoramic video generation. Spherical networks [ 10 , 11 , 37 ] and 360° scene understanding [ 38 ] process equirectangular imagery. Diffusion models generate panoramic images [ 49 ] , surround-view driving video [ 44 ] , and panoramic video [ 50 ] , and have been extended to 360° video with latitude- and longitude-aware mechanisms [ 45 ] and to high-resolution cubemap autoregression [ 24 ] . Panoramic depth estimation [ 32 ] provides geometric priors, and video generation models in turn recover HDR environment maps of the full surrounding scene [ 25 , 7 ] . None of them follows the camera motion of a navigation route, whereas SPW-Nav treats each equirectangular frame as a function on the sphere, on which rotation becomes exact resampling.
paragraphs.zh: 全景视频生成。 球面网络 [ 10 , 11 , 37 ] 和 360° 场景理解 [ 38 ] 处理等距圆柱投影图像。 扩散模型可生成全景图像 [ 49 ]、环绕视角驾驶视频 [ 44 ] 和全景视频 [ 50 ]，并已通过考虑纬度和经度的机制扩展至 360° 视频 [ 45 ]，以及高分辨率立方体映射自回归 [ 24 ]。 全景深度估计 [ 32 ] 提供几何先验，而视频生成模型则反过来恢复出完整周围场景的 HDR 环境贴图 [ 25 , 7 ]。 这些方法均未遵循导航路线的相机运动，而 SPW-Nav 则将每个等距圆柱投影帧视为球面上的一个函数，在该球面上旋转即成为精确的重采样。

paragraphs.en: Camera-controlled panoramic synthesis. CamPVG [ 21 ] conditions panoramic video on camera motion through spherical epipolar attention, OmniRoam [ 28 ] combines trajectory-controlled preview with temporal refinement, and PanoWorld [ 23 ] uses dense ray conditioning with geometry-aware memory. These methods take predefined trajectories rather than inferring motion from language, and GenDoP [ 51 ] generates camera trajectories from text but no video. Perspective camera-controlled generators [ 16 , 54 , 2 , 55 , 19 ] follow trajectories within a limited field of view, where a turn must synthesize new content, and LiVER [ 8 ] conditions generation on layout, lighting, and camera controls rendered from an explicit 3D scene proxy. SPW-Nav instead infers the movement from language in the previously generated panorama and retains context in a streaming memory as instructions change.

paragraphs.en: Navigation and interactive world models. World models predict future observations from past observations and actions, from latent dynamics [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 30 , 34 ] to high-resolution video diffusion [ 5 ] . Autoregressive video diffusion with few-step distillation further enables streaming generation [ 9 , 47 , 20 , 48 ] . NWM [ 4 ] predicts egocentric observations from navigation actions, and Genie [ 6 ] , Matrix-Game [ 52 , 17 ] , and Yume [ 29 ] generate explorable perspective worlds controlled by latent or keyboard actions. Such actions prescribe camera motion without scene semantics and cannot express instructions about scene content ( e.g . , walking to a door). Streaming benchmarks [ 27 ] report drift and slow interactive responses. SPW-Nav instead interprets each instruction semantically, localizing referenced objects and places in the generated panorama, and learns navigation and generation from complementary data.
paragraphs.zh: 导航与交互式世界模型。 世界模型根据过去的观察结果和行动预测未来的观察结果，涵盖从潜在动态 [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 30 , 34 ] 到高分辨率视频扩散 [ 5 ] 的多种方法。 结合少步蒸馏的自回归视频扩散技术进一步实现了流式生成 [ 9 , 47 , 20 , 48 ] 。 NWM [ 4 ] 根据导航行动预测以自我为中心的观察结果，而 Genie [ 6 ]、Matrix-Game [ 52 , 17 ] 和 Yume [ 29 ] 则能生成可通过潜在动作或键盘操作进行探索的视角化世界。 此类行动仅规定了摄像机的运动，却缺乏场景语义信息，因此无法表达关于场景内容的指令（例如，走到一扇门前）。 流式基准测试 [ 27 ] 指出存在漂移和交互式响应缓慢的问题。 SPW-Nav 则对每条指令进行语义解析，在生成的全景图中定位所提及的物体和地点，并通过互补数据学习导航与生成能力。

paragraphs.en: Real-world panoramic videos [ 40 ] cover diverse scenes with estimated camera trajectories, while offering limited control over camera motion and few paired movement instructions. paragraphs.en: Panoramic videos. The video backbone is trained on panoramic videos with camera trajectories. paragraphs.en: Instruction annotations. The vision-language backbone is trained on panoramas paired with movement instructions and motion targets. paragraphs.en: Multi-term memory. The memory ℳ k \mathcal{M}_{k} (Figure 2 , middle) holds the generated stream in three terms, the most recent latent frame, the two before it, and sixteen earlier ones, with older terms patchified more coarsely. A fixed anchor also keeps the first frame of the stream, which keeps the initial view visible throughout the stream. Memory tokens enter the transformer alongside the chunk tokens at noise level zero, and the first chunk starts from the input panorama repeated as a static clip. Since generation runs in the rotation-free orientation and each remembered panorama covers all directions, rotation never disturbs the memory and recent appearance in every direction stays available.
paragraphs.zh: 多术语记忆。 记忆模块 ℳ k \mathcal{M}_{k}（图 2，中间）存储了由三个术语组成的生成流：最新的潜在帧、其之前的两帧以及更早的十六帧，其中较旧的术语以更粗略的方式进行了补全。 一个固定锚点还保留该流的第一帧，从而在整个流中始终显示初始视图。 记忆令牌与块令牌一同以零噪声水平进入变换器，而第一个块则从作为静态片段重复的输入全景开始。 由于生成过程在无旋转方向下进行，且每个被记住的全景都覆盖了所有方向，因此旋转绝不会干扰记忆，并且每个方向上的近期外观始终可用。

sents.zh: 多术语记忆。

sents.en: The memory ℳ k \mathcal{M}_{k} (Figure 2 , middle) holds the generated stream in three terms, the most recent latent frame, the two before it, and sixteen earlier ones, with older terms patchified more coarsely.
sents.zh: 记忆模块 ℳ k \mathcal{M}_{k}（图 2，中间）存储了由三个术语组成的生成流：最新的潜在帧、其之前的两帧以及更早的十六帧，其中较旧的术语以更粗略的方式进行了补全。

sents.en: A fixed anchor also keeps the first frame of the stream, which keeps the initial view visible throughout the stream.
sents.zh: 一个固定锚点还保留该流的第一帧，从而在整个流中始终显示初始视图。

sents.en: Memory tokens enter the transformer alongside the chunk tokens at noise level zero, and the first chunk starts from the input panorama repeated as a static clip.
sents.zh: 记忆令牌与块令牌一同以零噪声水平进入变换器，而第一个块则从作为静态片段重复的输入全景开始。

sents.en: Since generation runs in the rotation-free orientation and each remembered panorama covers all directions, rotation never disturbs the memory and recent appearance in every direction stays available.
sents.zh: 由于生成过程在无旋转方向下进行，且每个被记住的全景都覆盖了所有方向，因此旋转绝不会干扰记忆，并且每个方向上的近期外观始终可用。

paragraphs.en: Few-step generation. Each chunk is denoised from coarse to fine over a spatial pyramid of three scales, which splits the noise range into equal thirds. The student uses two steps per scale (four for the first chunk). After the first chunk, each chunk takes six network evaluations plus two for the guidance of Eq. 5 . The student is initialized by ODE regression onto the teacher and trained with distribution matching distillation [ 46 ] , with the teacher as the real score and a critic tracking the student.
paragraphs.zh: 少步生成。 每个分块在三尺度空间金字塔上从粗略到精细进行去噪，该金字塔将噪声范围均分为三等份。 学生在每个尺度上使用两步（第一个分块使用四步）。 在第一个分块之后，每个分块需要六次网络评估，外加两次用于公式 5 的引导。 学生通过 ODE 回归到教师模型进行初始化，并通过分布匹配蒸馏 [46] 进行训练，其中教师模型作为真实得分函数，而一个批评者则跟踪学生的表现。

paragraphs.en: Streaming training. At inference the memory holds generated frames, whose errors differ from those of real video. ODE regression therefore uses histories from the model’s own rollouts, and distillation corrupts ground-truth histories with noise, downsampling, and saturation shifts with probability 0.9 0.9 , such that the student learns to continue from imperfect memory. Chunks do not overlap, and the memory alone carries continuity across chunks and instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 流式训练。 在推理阶段，内存中存储着生成的帧，其错误与真实视频中的错误存在差异。 因此，ODE 回归使用模型自身展开过程中的历史数据，而蒸馏则以 0.9 0.9 的概率用噪声、降采样和饱和度偏移来污染真实历史数据，从而使学生能够基于不完整的记忆进行延续学习。 各数据块之间没有重叠，且仅凭内存即可在不同数据块和指令之间保持连续性。

paragraphs.en: Implementation details. The video backbone is Wan2.2-TI2V-5B [ 41 ] fine-tuned with LoRA on panoramic video and produces 1024 × 2048 1024\times 2048 video with a playback rate of 16 FPS. It is trained without language on the rotation-free videos of SPW-NavSet in autoregressive, pyramid, and trajectory-conditioned stages, and then distilled into a few-step student (see appendix).

paragraphs.en: Baselines. We compare with generators that accept camera motion, each through its own interface. The baselines are NWM [ 4 ] , CubeComposer [ 24 ] , OmniRoam [ 28 ] , and the Action and Causal variants of PanoWorld [ 23 ] , denoted PanoWorld-A. and PanoWorld-C. CubeComposer completes a perspective video into a panorama and takes neither trajectory nor language. It therefore appears only in camera-controlled generation. For camera-controlled and long video generation, we add Matrix-Game 3.0 [ 43 ] , a streaming world model with long-horizon memory driven by keyboard and mouse actions in a perspective view. Matrix-Game 3.0 is evaluated in its native view and as a panorama completed by CubeComposer. The comparison with perspective generators Stable Virtual Camera [ 55 ] , ReCamMaster [ 2 ] , CamI2V [ 54 ] , HunyuanWorld-Voyager [ 19 ] , and CameraCtrl [ 16 ] appears in the appendix.

paragraphs.en: Metrics. Camera-following accuracy is measured on the camera motion estimated from the generated video [ 42 ] by the trajectory direction error (TDE), the cumulative and per-interval rotation errors (RE and RPE R ), the error of the mean cumulative rotation ( Δ \Delta Rot.), a scale-free trajectory shape error (ATE), and motion accuracy (MA). Video quality is measured by PSNR, LPIPS, and FVD. The appendix gives the exact definitions.
paragraphs.zh: 指标。 摄像头跟随准确性通过轨迹方向误差（TDE）、累积及每时段旋转误差（RE 和 RPE R）、平均累积旋转误差（Δ \Delta Rot.）、无量纲的轨迹形状误差（ATE）以及运动准确性（MA）来衡量，这些指标基于从生成视频中估计出的摄像头运动 [42]。 视频质量通过 PSNR、LPIPS 和 FVD 进行衡量。 附录中给出了精确的定义。

paragraphs.en: We first evaluate the full system, from a language instruction to panoramic video, and start every method from the same motion instruction of each SPW-NavBench clip. No prior panoramic generator understands movement instructions semantically, which is the gap SPW-Nav addresses. Each baseline therefore receives the instruction through the closest interface it offers. PanoWorld and OmniRoam take it in their text prompt with the motion preset matching its keywords, and NWM takes the actions planned by our vision-language backbone without fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先评估整个系统，从语言指令到全景视频，并且对每个 SPW-NavBench 片段都从相同的运动指令开始运行每种方法。 目前没有任何全景生成器能够语义上理解运动指令，而这正是 SPW-Nav 所填补的空白。 因此，每个基线模型都通过其提供的最接近的接口接收该指令。 PanoWorld 和 OmniRoam 会在文本提示中结合与其关键词匹配的运动预设来接收指令，而 NWM 则无需微调即可执行由我们的视觉-语言主干模型规划出的动作。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 shows that SPW-Nav leads on every measure except ATE, where the keyword-matched presets give PanoWorld a predefined trajectory shape while SPW-Nav infers the trajectory from the instruction and the scene. SPW-Nav reaches a TDE of 56.66 ∘ 56.66^{\circ} against at least 62.07 ∘ 62.07^{\circ} and an FVD of 351.6 against at least 628.8, and its RE is less than one quarter of that of any baseline, since SRD applies the interpreted rotation exactly while the baselines rotate only slightly. Both PanoWorld variants also lose about 5 dB of PSNR relative to Table 2 , whereas SPW-Nav loses less than 1 dB. Replacing the fine-tuned backbone with its base model raises TDE to 100.74 ∘ 100.74^{\circ} and lowers MA to 0.028, since the base model often misreads the commanded direction.

paragraphs.en: Navigation accuracy. On the navigation instructions of SPW-NavBench (40 explicit and 60 goal instructions, see appendix), the vision-language backbone interprets all explicit instructions correctly and localizes 62% of the visible targets. On the held-out test scene, fine-tuning raises the accuracy from 0.663 to 0.925 for explicit instructions and from 0.154 to 0.692 for goal instructions. Without the panorama, goal localization drops to zero, which indicates that goals are located in the image rather than guessed from the words. On the motion instructions, it matches the commanded direction for 98% of the instructions with a mean distance error of 0.03 m relative to the commanded distance.
paragraphs.zh: 导航准确性。 在 SPW-NavBench 的导航指令（40 条显式指令和 60 条目标指令，见附录）上，视觉-语言主干模型能正确解释所有显式指令，并定位到 62% 的可见目标。 在预留的测试场景中，微调将显式指令的准确率从 0.663 提升至 0.925，将目标指令的准确率从 0.154 提升至 0.692。 如果没有全景图像，目标定位准确率会降至零，这表明目标是基于图像而非通过文字猜测来定位的。 在运动指令方面，对于 98% 的指令，模型能够匹配所命令的方向，相对于命令距离的平均距离误差为 0.03 米。

paragraphs.en: We then isolate the video backbone by giving every method the ground-truth camera trajectory instead of language. SPW-Nav and OmniRoam take the full trajectory, the PanoWorld variants take its translation with a fixed heading, NWM takes the corresponding actions with three ground-truth past views, and CubeComposer takes a perspective video rendered along the commanded rotation.
paragraphs.zh: 接着，我们通过为每种方法提供真实的相机轨迹而非语言信息，来隔离视频主干。 SPW-Nav 和 OmniRoam 使用完整的轨迹；PanoWorld 的变体使用具有固定方向的平移；NWM 使用与三个真实历史视图相对应的动作；而 CubeComposer 则使用沿指定旋转渲染出的视角视频。

paragraphs.en: Long video generation. SPW-Nav streams one minute of continuous 2K panoramic video (960 frames at 16 FPS) from a single panorama, including panoramas outside its training data (appendix Figures 71 and 72 ). Such long streams must stay consistent when a route returns to its start. For each of 20 scenes, we run two closed routes ( i.e . , the final pose equals the initial one) of twelve chunks (see appendix). Memory gain measures how much closer a revisited view is to its earlier observation than a non-revisiting view, and closure errors compare the final and initial poses. Table 3 compares SPW-Nav with OmniRoam, PanoWorld-A., HunyuanWorld-Voyager, and Matrix-Game 3.0, where the last two are evaluated in their native perspective view. SPW-Nav closes the loop with a rotation error of 1.62 ∘ 1.62^{\circ} , against 8.91 ∘ 8.91^{\circ} for HunyuanWorld-Voyager, the next best, and up to 39.52 ∘ 39.52^{\circ} for PanoWorld-A. It also reaches the lowest translation closure error, 30.7%. Matrix-Game 3.0 reaches a higher memory gain than SPW-Nav (0.249 in its perspective view and 0.204 as a panorama, against 0.173), but its closure rotation error exceeds 22 ∘ 22^{\circ} in both settings.
paragraphs.zh: 长视频生成。 SPW-Nav 从单个全景图中流式传输一分钟的连续 2K 全景视频（960 帧，16 FPS），其中包含其训练数据之外的全景图（附录图 71 和 72）。 当路线返回起点时，此类长视频流必须保持一致性。 对于 20 个场景中的每个场景，我们运行两条闭合路线（即最终姿态等于初始姿态），每条路线由十二个片段组成（见附录）。 记忆增益衡量的是：重访视角与其早期观察相比，较非重访视角更接近的程度；而闭合误差则比较最终姿态与初始姿态。 表 3 将 SPW-Nav 与 OmniRoam、PanoWorld-A、HunyuanWorld-Voyager 和 Matrix-Game 3.0 进行了比较，其中后两者是在其原生视角模式下进行评估的。 SPW-Nav 的旋转闭合误差为 1.62°（1.62^{\circ}），而次优的 HunyuanWorld-Voyager 为 8.91°（8.91^{\circ}），PanoWorld-A 甚至高达 39.52°（39.52^{\circ}）。 它还实现了最低的平移闭合误差，为 30.7%。 Matrix-Game 3.0 的记忆增益高于 SPW-Nav（其视角模式下为 0.249，全景图模式下为 0.204，而 SPW-Nav 为 0.173），但在两种设置中，其旋转闭合误差均超过 22°（22^{\circ}）。

paragraphs.en: Instruction switching. New instructions may arrive at any time. We run 20 scenes through four consecutive instructions spanning twelve chunks (about 25 seconds), where the vision-language backbone reads the last generated frame before every instruction and the memory holds only generated frames. Figure 4 shows examples, and Table 72 lists per-segment metrics. Instruction-following metrics fluctuate across segments, while FVD is higher after the first segment. Switches cause no visible jump, as inter-frame LPIPS across instruction boundaries is no higher than within segments. With eight H200 GPUs and sparse attention, SPW-Nav generates 26.6 frames per second, faster than the 16 FPS playback rate of its output.
paragraphs.zh: 指令切换。 新指令可能随时到达。 我们让模型在四个连续指令（共十二个片段，约 25 秒）中运行 20 个场景；其中，视觉-语言主干模型在每个指令前读取最后生成的帧，而记忆仅保留已生成的帧。 图 4 展示了示例，表 72 列出了各分段的指标。 指令遵循指标在不同分段间存在波动，而 FVD 在第一分段之后更高。 切换并未造成明显的跳跃，因为跨指令边界的帧间 LPIPS 值并不高于分段内部的值。 使用八块 H200 GPU 和稀疏注意力机制，SPW-Nav 的生成速率为每秒 26.6 帧，快于其输出内容的 16 FPS 播放速率。

paragraphs.en: We present SPW-Nav, a streaming panoramic world model that interprets each language instruction in the previously generated panorama and streams one minute of 2K 360° video at 26.6 FPS. Spherical rotation decoupling makes rotation exact, pose-aligned conditioning keeps translation inputs bounded, and noise-tail trajectory learning with opposite-trajectory guidance strengthens translation following. SPW-Nav outperforms existing panoramic generators in camera-following accuracy and video quality and closes long routes with near-exact rotation, making language a practical interface for exploring generated worlds. Since generation runs faster than playback, new instructions can be issued while the stream plays. Consistency on distant revisits and the trajectory shape of translation remain open. In future work, a pose-indexed 3D memory could make distant revisits more consistent, and more diverse training trajectories could improve the shape of translation. Motion targets could also come from clicks on the panorama or external planners, since the video backbone receives camera trajectories rather than language.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SPW-Nav，这是一种流式全景世界模型，它能对先前生成的全景图中的每条语言指令进行解析，并以 26.6 FPS 的帧率连续播放一分钟的 2K 360° 视频。 球面旋转解耦使旋转更加精确，与姿态对齐的条件约束使平移输入保持有限，而结合反向轨迹引导的噪声尾部轨迹学习则增强了平移跟随能力。 SPW-Nav 在摄像头跟随精度和视频质量方面优于现有的全景生成模型，并能以近乎精确的旋转完成长距离路线规划，使语言成为探索生成世界的一种实用接口。 由于生成速度比播放速度快，因此可以在视频流播放的同时发出新的指令。 对远距离重访时的一致性以及平移轨迹的形状问题仍有待进一步研究。 在未来的工作中，采用姿态索引的三维记忆机制可能使远距离重访更具一致性，而更多样化的训练轨迹则可能改善平移轨迹的形状。 运动目标也可以来自对全景图的点击或外部规划器，因为视频主干接收的是摄像头轨迹而非语言指令。

sents.zh: SPW-Nav 在摄像头跟随精度和视频质量方面优于现有的全景生成模型，并能以近乎精确的旋转完成长距离路线规划，使语言成为探索生成世界的一种实用接口。

sents.en: Since generation runs faster than playback, new instructions can be issued while the stream plays.
sents.zh: 由于生成速度比播放速度快，因此可以在视频流播放的同时发出新的指令。

sents.en: Consistency on distant revisits and the trajectory shape of translation remain open.
sents.zh: 对远距离重访时的一致性以及平移轨迹的形状问题仍有待进一步研究。

sents.en: In future work, a pose-indexed 3D memory could make distant revisits more consistent, and more diverse training trajectories could improve the shape of translation.
sents.zh: 在未来的工作中，采用姿态索引的三维记忆机制可能使远距离重访更具一致性，而更多样化的训练轨迹则可能改善平移轨迹的形状。

sents.en: Motion targets could also come from clicks on the panorama or external planners, since the video backbone receives camera trajectories rather than language.
sents.zh: 运动目标也可以来自对全景图的点击或外部规划器，因为视频主干接收的是摄像头轨迹而非语言指令。

paragraphs.en: We use two groups of metrics. For the video-generation metrics, camera motion is estimated from forward crops of the generated video with a VGGT-based estimator. Trajectory direction error (TDE) is the angle between the commanded and estimated translation directions, rotation error (RE) is the error of the cumulative rotation, and RPE R is the rotation error per interval. Δ \Delta Rot. is the absolute difference between the mean estimated cumulative rotation and the mean commanded rotation. ATE is a scale-free trajectory shape error, and motion accuracy (MA) is the fraction of evaluation intervals whose motion follows the commanded direction. PSNR on the forward view, LPIPS averaged over four viewing directions, and FVD measure video quality. Memory gain compares a revisited view with its earlier observation, relative to a non-revisiting view at the same time gap, and closure errors compare the final estimated pose with the initial one. The navigation-target metrics evaluate the vision-language backbone alone. A displacement target is correct when its path is within max ⁡ ( 0.15 ​ m , 10 % ) \max(0.15\,\text{m},10\%) of the commanded excursion and its heading within 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} . A goal target is correct when its box overlaps the annotated target with an IoU of at least 0.3 and its center bearing is within 20 ∘ 20^{\circ} . The Action and Goal columns of the navigation table report these accuracies.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用两组指标。 对于视频生成指标，我们通过基于 VGGT 的估计器，从生成视频的前向裁剪帧中估算相机运动。 轨迹方向误差（TDE）是指令平移方向与估算平移方向之间的夹角；旋转误差（RE）是累积旋转的误差；RPE R 是每个时间间隔的旋转误差。Δ \Delta Rot. 是平均估算累积旋转与平均指令旋转之间的绝对差值。 ATE 是一种无量纲的轨迹形状误差，而运动精度（MA）是指运动中遵循指令方向的评价时间间隔所占的比例。 前向视图的 PSNR、四个观察方向上的平均 LPIPS 以及 FVD 用于衡量视频质量。 记忆增益将重访视角与其早期的观察结果进行比较，并与相同时间间隔内未重访的视角进行比较；闭合误差则将最终估算的姿态与初始姿态进行比较。 导航目标指标仅评估视觉-语言主干模型。 当位移目标的轨迹在指令移动距离的 max ⁡ ( 0.15 ​ m , 10 % ) \max(0.15\,\text{m},10\%) 范围内，且其航向在 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} 以内时，该目标即为正确。 当目标框与标注目标的重叠度（IoU）至少为 0.3，且其中心方位角在 20 ∘ 20^{\circ} 以内时，该目标即为正确。 导航表中的“动作”和“目标”列报告了这些精度指标。

paragraphs.en: The multi-term memory of generated frames already keeps revisited views consistent and closes long routes with near-exact rotation. A more explicit memory ( e.g . , a pose-indexed 3D scene representation) could make consistency on distant revisits more reliable, although advancing memory mechanisms for video generation may also achieve this within the video itself. More diverse training trajectories could further improve the trajectory shape of translation.
paragraphs.zh: 生成帧的多项记忆已经能够保持重复访问视角的一致性，并以近乎精确的旋转闭合长路径。 更明确的记忆（例如，以姿态为索引的三维场景表示）可以使远距离重复访问时的一致性更加可靠，尽管用于视频生成的先进记忆机制也可能在视频本身内部实现这一点。 更多样化的训练轨迹可以进一步改善平移的轨迹形状。

paragraphs.en: Instruction annotations. Explicit instructions cover translation in four directions, pure turns, stopping, corrections, out-and-back routes, and two-leg routes, with varied distances, English and Chinese phrasings, and varied background panoramas. Each goal is labeled with a bounding box and an approach distance, verified by two vision-language teachers, and augmented by rotating the panorama and its box together. The annotations span 68 unique goals from four indoor scenes. Two scenes provide the training set, and validation and test sets of 128 and 132 instructions come from the two remaining scenes, whose action wording and distances are also absent from training.

paragraphs.en: Curation pipeline. For the outdoor videos, we discard MUGEN clips whose camera stays nearly static and clips that only rotate in place, resample the remaining clips to be rotation-free, and replace their captions with a neutral scene prompt, which leaves 9,609 clips. For the instruction annotations, explicit instructions are derived from camera trajectories, and their motion targets are therefore exact by construction. A goal candidate is kept only after two vision-language teachers verify it.
paragraphs.zh: 内容筛选流程。 对于户外视频，我们丢弃了摄像机几乎静止不动的 MUGEN 片段以及仅在原地旋转的片段，对剩余的片段进行重新采样以消除旋转，并将它们的字幕替换为中立场景提示，最终保留了 9,609 个片段。 对于指令标注，明确指令是从摄像机轨迹中推导出来的，因此其运动目标在构造上就是精确的。 一个目标候选项只有在经过两个视觉-语言教师的验证后才会被保留。

paragraphs.en: Backbone and representation. The video backbone is Wan2.2-TI2V-5B [ 41 ] fine-tuned on panoramic video, with LoRA of rank 256 on its linear layers. Its VAE compresses frames by 16 × 16\times spatially and 4 × 4\times temporally, giving a 64 × 128 64\times 128 latent grid. Decoding pads the latents by two columns copied from the opposite side, preserving continuity at the left and right panorama borders. Generated videos have resolution 1024 × 2048 1024\times 2048 and 16 FPS.
paragraphs.zh: 主干网络与表示。 视频主干网络为 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B [ 41 ]，在全景视频上进行微调，其线性层采用秩为 256 的 LoRA。 其 VAE 在空间上以 16 × 16\times、时间上以 4 × 4\times 的比例压缩帧，从而得到 64 × 128 64\times 128 的潜在网格。 解码时通过从对侧复制两列来填充潜在表示，从而保持左右全景边界处的连续性。 生成的视频分辨率为 1024 × 2048 1024\times 2048，帧率为 16 FPS。

paragraphs.en: Training schedule. The video backbone is trained without language on the rotation-free videos in three stages, autoregressive training with the multi-term memory (10,000 steps), pyramid training (4,000 and 9,500 steps), and trajectory-conditioned training (28,832 steps). The student is initialized by 10,000 ODE-regression steps and distilled for 3,500 steps, 1,500 over the full noise range followed by 2,000 with noise-tail sampling, with learning rates of 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} (generator) and 4 × 10 − 7 4\times 10^{-7} (critic), five critic updates per generator step, and an EMA decay of 0.99.
paragraphs.zh: 训练计划。 视频主干网络在三个阶段中，无需语言信息地在无旋转视频中训练：多项记忆自回归训练（10,000步）、金字塔训练（4,000步和9,500步），以及轨迹条件训练（28,832步）。 学生模型通过10,000步ODE回归初始化，并进行3,500步蒸馏：其中前1,500步覆盖完整噪声范围，后2,000步采用噪声尾部采样；学习率分别为2 × 10⁻⁶（生成器）和4 × 10⁻⁷（判别器），每步生成器更新对应五次判别器更新，EMA衰减系数为0.99。

paragraphs.en: Panoramic interfaces. NWM [ 4 ] predicts 224 × 224 224\times 224 perspective views from navigation actions and additionally receives three ground-truth past views, as required by its interface. CubeComposer [ 24 ] completes a perspective video into a panorama. Since it takes no trajectory, we repeat the first panorama as a static clip and render its perspective input along the commanded rotation. It thus receives no translation. OmniRoam [ 28 ] takes the full camera trajectory. The Action and Causal variants of PanoWorld [ 23 ] fix the heading and receive translation only. All panoramic baselines generate 81 frames at 960 × 480 960\times 480 , except CubeComposer, which generates 27 frames at 1536 × 3072 1536\times 3072 . All are evaluated at matching timestamps.
paragraphs.zh: 全景界面。 NWM [ 4 ] 根据导航动作预测出 224 × 224 的 224\times 224 视角视图，并额外接收三个历史真实视图，以满足其接口的要求。 CubeComposer [ 24 ] 将一段视角视频合成全景图。 由于它不接收任何轨迹，我们将第一个全景图重复作为静态片段，并沿指令旋转渲染其视角输入。 因此，它没有接收到任何平移信息。 OmniRoam [ 28 ] 接收完整的相机轨迹。 PanoWorld [ 23 ] 的 Action 和 Causal 变体固定航向，仅接收平移信息。 所有全景基线方法均生成 960 × 480 的 960\times 480 共 81 帧图像，CubeComposer 除外，它生成 1536 × 3072 的 1536\times 3072 共 27 帧图像。 所有方法均在对应的时间戳上进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Proposition 1 justifies both halves of spherical rotation decoupling. By (i), the rotation-free training videos are genuine translation-only videos of the original scenes, so the video backbone learns real parallax rather than an artificial warp. By (ii) and (iii), a model that generates the rotation-free video for the commanded translations and then applies R 0 ⊤ ​ R n R_{0}^{\top}R_{n} frame by frame produces the video of the full trajectory, and the rotation never needs to be generated.
paragraphs.zh: 命题 1 为球面旋转解耦的两个部分提供了依据。 根据 (i)，无旋转训练视频是原始场景的真实纯平移视频，因此视频主干网络学习的是真实的视差，而非人为的扭曲。 根据 (ii) 和 (iii)，一个模型先为指定的平移生成无旋转视频，然后逐帧应用 R₀ᵀRₙ，即可生成完整轨迹的视频，且无需生成任何旋转。
